meta.title: Cloning a PR-created event is refused
gaps: the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: No setup recipe creates an active event created from a purchase request; published_rfq does not guarantee the required PR-created state.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the event groups create clone request, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Events with purchase requests cannot be cloned.”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: Cloning a PR-created event is refused

expected.message: Events with purchase requests cannot be cloned.
